Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Petra Lechner,

We acknowledge your offer and the cost-index movements and cost shares you have provided. We recognise that larger adjustments require management approval and ask you to defer the increase and extend the payment terms within your delegated authority.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months, 6,110 units in total.
2. Our proposal: EUR 361.96 per unit, 90 days net, no price-adjustment clause. This amounts to about EUR 2,211,576 over the term.
3. Basis: Our demand forecast for this part is up +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09), and we commit 6,110 units a year. Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10).
4. Next step: All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of these terms we will issue the order.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have reviewed your proposal and acknowledge the verified decrease in PPI-C241 as well as your volume commitment of 6,110 units. However, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost. That remains. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Extending the payment terms to 90 days would necessitate a higher unit price, hence we have maintained the 30 days net term to provide a more competitive rate. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our Angebot is a price of €372.52 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Consequently, we propose a revised price of €368.42 per unit. At our standard terms, we offer a price of €368.42 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €368.42 per unit.

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

We have verified your recent order history; however, past prices do not reflect our current cost structure.

- Zahlungsziel: 90 days net
